name: Tag → Set Emulation Message
description: Use this action to set the NDEF message used for card (tag) emulation mode, when enabled (see below).

config_entries.label: Message
config_entries.description: The string to include in the (emulated) tag's first NDEF record; typically a URL as shown.

config_entries.label: Include Android App Record
config_entries.description: Include a second NDEF record required for some Android operating systems. Defaults to `true`.
